support.title: Support the project
support.description: Dzvonyk is built and maintained by one person
support.free: Dzvonyk is free. The source is open (AGPL-3.0) and may be used freely.
support.body: If Dzvonyk saved you time, you can support the project. Contributions go towards hosting and development. If your school cannot afford it, simply use it — that is fine.
support.feedbackBody: Feedback is worth more than a donation right now. If something broke or is missing, write to {{email}}.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Follow these steps to create your timetable

steps.1: Set up your time structure (days and hours) in Settings
steps.2: Add teachers who will be teaching
steps.4: Define student years, groups, and subgroups
steps.5: Create lessons linking teachers, subjects, and students

BasicCompulsoryTime.label: Basic Compulsory Time
BasicCompulsoryTime.description: Ensures lessons don't overlap for the same teacher/students. Required for valid timetables.

BreakTimes.label: Break Times
BreakTimes.description: Define break periods when no lessons can be scheduled.

TeacherNotAvailableTimes.label: Teacher Not Available Times
TeacherNotAvailableTimes.description: Specify times when a specific teacher is unavailable to teach.

TeacherMaxDaysPerWeek.label: Teacher Max Days Per Week
TeacherMaxDaysPerWeek.description: Limit the maximum number of days a teacher can work in a week.

TeacherMaxHoursDaily.label: Teacher Max Hours Daily
TeacherMaxHoursDaily.description: Limit the maximum hours a teacher can work in a single day.

TeacherMaxGapsPerWeek.label: Teacher Max Gaps Per Week
TeacherMaxGapsPerWeek.description: Limit the maximum number of gaps (free periods between classes) for a teacher in a week.

TeacherMaxGapsPerDay.label: Teacher Max Gaps Per Day
TeacherMaxGapsPerDay.description: Limit the maximum number of gaps for a teacher in a single day.

TeachersMaxHoursDaily.label: All Teachers Max Hours Daily
TeachersMaxHoursDaily.description: Limit the maximum hours all teachers can work in a single day.

StudentsSetNotAvailableTimes.label: Students Not Available Times
StudentsSetNotAvailableTimes.description: Specify times when a student group is unavailable.

StudentsSetMaxHoursDaily.label: Students Max Hours Daily
StudentsSetMaxHoursDaily.description: Limit the maximum hours a student group can have classes in a single day.

StudentsSetMaxGapsPerWeek.label: Students Max Gaps Per Week
StudentsSetMaxGapsPerWeek.description: Limit the maximum gaps for a student group in a week.

MinDaysBetweenActivities.label: Min Days Between Lessons
MinDaysBetweenActivities.description: Ensure minimum days between split lessons (e.g., same subject on different days).

ActivitiesSameStartingTime.label: Lessons Same Starting Time
ActivitiesSameStartingTime.description: Force a set of lessons to start at the same time.

ActivitiesNotOverlapping.label: Lessons Not Overlapping
ActivitiesNotOverlapping.description: Ensure a set of lessons do not overlap in time.

ActivityPreferredStartingTime.label: Lesson Preferred Starting Time
ActivityPreferredStartingTime.description: Set a preferred or locked starting time for a lesson.

spaceConstraints.addDescription: Select a constraint type to add
spaceConstraints.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this constraint?

BasicCompulsorySpace.label: Basic Compulsory Space
BasicCompulsorySpace.description: Ensures rooms don't have overlapping lessons. Required for valid timetables.

RoomNotAvailableTimes.label: Room Not Available Times
RoomNotAvailableTimes.description: Specify times when a room is unavailable.

ActivityPreferredRoom.label: Lesson Preferred Room
ActivityPreferredRoom.description: Set a preferred room for a specific lesson.

ActivityPreferredRooms.label: Lesson Preferred Rooms
ActivityPreferredRooms.description: Set multiple preferred rooms for a lesson (any can be used).

SubjectPreferredRoom.label: Subject Preferred Room
SubjectPreferredRoom.description: All lessons for a subject should use this room.

SubjectPreferredRooms.label: Subject Preferred Rooms
SubjectPreferredRooms.description: All lessons for a subject can use any of these rooms.

SubjectActivityTagPreferredRoom.label: Subject + Activity Tag Preferred Room

SubjectActivityTagPreferredRooms.label: Subject + Activity Tag Preferred Rooms
SubjectActivityTagPreferredRooms.description: Lessons with specific subject and activity tag can use any of these rooms.

TeacherHomeRoom.label: Teacher Home Room

TeacherHomeRooms.label: Teacher Home Rooms
TeacherHomeRooms.description: Define multiple home rooms for a teacher.

StudentsSetHomeRooms.description: Define multiple home rooms for a student group.

ActivityTagPreferredRoom.label: Activity Tag Preferred Room
ActivityTagPreferredRoom.description: All lessons with this tag should use this room.

ActivityTagPreferredRooms.label: Activity Tag Preferred Rooms
ActivityTagPreferredRooms.description: All lessons with this tag can use any of these rooms.
